description: Return the machine-readable submission rules for selling software on Crela (required fields, KO rules, bundle rules). Public, no sign-in required. Use it to check whether a project fits Crela before building. Uploading builds and screenshots needs files from disk and is only available in the local server (npx -y @crela/mcp). This server manages existing software: list_my_software, check_review_status, get_review_report, set_metadata.
name: get_submission_requirements
title: Get Crela submission requirements
